content: Wuu si bɑ Lefin bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Lefin bwese kɛrɑn bukurobu bɑ nɑ bɑ yɑ̃ku kowo Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Yosue Nunin bii kɑ Isirelin bwese kɛri yi yi tien bukurobu deemɑ
Siloɔ Kɑnɑnin temɔ. Bɑ nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u Mɔwisi woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, u sun wusu wɛ̃ mi sɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ kpɑrɑ yenu.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ wusu ɡɑsu ɡɔsɑ ben bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyeren tem sɔɔ kɑ kpɑrɑ yenu bɑ Lefibɑ wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u Mɔwisi sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Ye bɑ wuu si bɔnu mɔ̀ kɑ tɛtɛ, Kehɑtin yɛnuɡibu be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Aroni yɑ̃ku kowon bibu, beyɑ bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ tɛtɛ di. Wusu wɔkurɑ itɑwɑ bɑ wɑ Yudɑbɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Simɛɔbɑɡim sɔɔ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑɡim sɔɔ.
Ben be bɑ mɑɑ tie yɛnu ɡe sɔɔ, beyɑ bɑ wusu wɔkuru tɛtɛ di si su wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑimubɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Dɑnubɑɡim sɔɔ kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑn tem sɔɔ.
Gɛɛsɔnin yɛnuɡibu bɑ mɑɑ wusu wɔkurɑ itɑ tɛtɛ di si su wɑ̃ɑ Isɑkɑribɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Asɛɛbɑɡim sɔɔ, kɑ Nɛfitɑlibɑɡim sɔɔ kɑ Mɑnɑsebɑɡim sɔɔ mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ Bɑsɑniɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerɔ.
Mɛrɑrin yɛnuɡibu, be, bɑ mɑɑ wusu wɔkurɑ yiru tɛtɛ di si su wɑ̃ɑ Rubɛnibɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Gɑdibɑɡim sɔɔ kɑ Sɑbulonibɑɡim sɔɔ.
Mɛyɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ Lefin bwese kɛrɑ ye wuu si wɛ̃ kɑ sin kpɑrɑ yenu nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u Mɔwisi sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Lefin tɔn be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Kehɑtin yɛnuɡibu Aronin bweseru sɔɔ, beyɑ bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ tɛtɛ di. Wuu si bɑ wɑ Yudɑbɑn tem sɔɔ kɑ Simɛɔbɑɡim sɔɔ, si wee.
Bɑ bu Aribɑn wuu wɛ̃ ɡe bɑ rɑ mɑɑ soku Heboroni kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu. Anɑkibɑn sikɑdo Aribɑn yĩsirɑ bɑ kɑ ɡu sokumɔ. Gɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Yudɑn ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ.
Gen ɡberu kpɑɑnɛbɑrɑ bɑ rɑɑ Kɑlɛbu Yɛfunɛn bii wɛ̃.
Heboroni yen biru, bɑ mɑɑ bu Libinɑ wɛ̃,
kɑ Yɑtiri kɑ Ɛsitemɔɑ,
kɑ Holoni, kɑ Debiri,
kɑ Aini, kɑ Yutɑ, kɑ Bɛti Semɛsi. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu nɔɔbɑ nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu. Yudɑbɑ kɑ Simɛɔbɑn tem sɔɔrɑ si kpuro su wɑ̃ɑ.
Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑn tem sɔɔ, bɑ Gɑbɑoni tɛtɛ di kɑ Gebɑ,
kɑ Anɑtɔtu kɑ Alimɔɔ. Wusu nnɛwɑ mi, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si kpuro, si bɑ yɑ̃ku kowo Aronin bweseru wɛ̃ su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔkurɑ itɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Kehɑtin yɛnuɡii be bɑ tie Aronin bwese te sɔɔ, bɑ mɑɑ wusu wɑ Efɑrɑimubɑn tem sɔɔ.
Siyɑ Sikɛmu ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑimun ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ mi bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de, kɑ Gesɛɛ,
kɑ Kibisɑimu kɑ Bɛti Horoni. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Dɑnubɑn tem sɔɔ, bɑ bu Ɛliteke wɛ̃ kɑ Gibetoni,
kɑ Ayɑloni kɑ Gɑti Rimɔɔ. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑn temɔ be, bɑ mɑɑ bu wusu yiru wɛ̃, Tɑnɑki kɑ Gɑti Rimɔɔ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si bɑ bu wɛ̃ mi kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔkuru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.

Lefi be bɑ tie bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gɛɛsɔnin yɛnuɡibu, bɑ mɑɑ wusu yiru wɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑn temɔ. Wuu siyɑ Golɑni, Bɑsɑnin temɔ mi bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de kɑ Bɛsitɑrɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Isɑkɑribɑn tem sɔɔ, bɑ bu Kisioni wɛ̃ kɑ Dɑbɑrɑti,
kɑ Yɑɑmuti, kɑ Eni Gɑnimu. Si kpuro su kuɑwɑ wusu nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Asɛɛbɑn tem sɔɔ, bɑ bu Mikɑli kɑ Abudoni kɑ Hɛlikɑti
kɑ Rehɔbu wɛ̃. Si kpuro su kuɑwɑ wusu nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Nɛfitɑlibɑɡim sɔɔ mɑɑ, bɑ bu Kedɛsi wɛ̃ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlilen temɔ, mi bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de, kɑ Hɑmɔti Dori, kɑ Kɑɑtɑni. Siyɑ su kuɑ wusu itɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Wuu si Gɛɛsɔni be, bɑ tɛtɛ di mi, su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔkurɑ itɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Mɛrɑribɑ Lefin bwese te sɔɔ, bɑ mɑɑ bu wusu nnɛ wɛ̃, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu Sɑbulonibɑn tem sɔɔ. Wuu siyɑ Yokunɛɑmu kɑ Kɑɑtɑ
kɑ Dimmɑ kɑ Nɑhɑlɑli.
Rubɛnibɑn tem sɔɔ bɑ bu wusu nnɛ wɛ̃, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu. Siyɑ Besɛɛ kɑ Yɑsɑ,
kɑ Kedemɔti kɑ Mɛfɑti.
Gɑdibɑn tem sɔɔ, Mɛrɑri be, bɑ mɑɑ wusu nnɛ wɑ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu. Wuu siyɑ Mɑhɑnɑimu kɑ Hɛsiboni kɑ Yesɛɛ kɑ Rɑmɔti ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdin temɔ, mi bɑ ko n dɑ kpikiru de.
Wuu si Mɛrɑri be, bɑ tɛtɛ di, si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔkurɑ yiru.
Wuu si Lefin bwese kɛri yi wɑ Isirelin bwese kɛri yi yi tien mi, su kuɑwɑ weerɑɑkuru yiru sɑri, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen kpɑrɑ yenu.
Nɡe mɛsumɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Isirelibɑ tem mɛ kpuro wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ u ben sikɑdobɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ. Mɑ bɑ sinɑ mɛ sɔɔ, mu kuɑ beɡim.
Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ derɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ben sikɑdobɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ. U bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ kpuro nɔmu bɛriɑ. Ben ɡoo sɑri wi u kɑ tii yinɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ win nɔɔ mwɛɛ ni kpuro yibiɑ ni u Isirelibɑ kuɑ, bɑɑ nin teeru tɑ ǹ kɑm wɔrɑ.
Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri
yi yi wɑ̃ɑ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ,
yi ɡɔsirɑ yin temɔ
